title: Why fans circled January 7 | Conformity Gate Part 5

shots.vo: If there was a secret Episode 9, fans were sure of the date: January 7th. A die showing seven appears near the end of the finale.
shots.prompt: A 20-sided die tumbling in slow motion across a green felt table and landing on the number 7, low-key light, red accent

shots.vo: In the very first episode, Will says his roll was a seven, the night he vanishes. And a Netflix teaser at Christmas carried that same date.
shots.prompt: A 1980s paper wall calendar with January 7 circled in thick red marker, slow push-in, a lamp flickering nearby

shots.vo: The pieces seemed to fit. So on January 7th... fans waited.
shots.prompt: An analog wall clock ticking toward midnight in a dark kitchen, slow push-in on the second hand, cold blue moonlight

caption: Why did Stranger Things fans circle January 7? The dice, Will's roll, and a Netflix teaser. Part 6: the night it all ended.
factNote: The die and teaser are real. The secret-episode link was a theory.
